Lady '''Nelein Matherin''' was an [[Andor]]an [[nobility|noblewoman]] of [[House Matherin]].

==History==
She was [[Lord]] [[Aedmun Matherin]]'s grandmother.

=="Activities"==
Due to the [[Dark One]]'s influence on the world, Lady Nelein appeared as a ghost to a maid, [[Elsie]], which frightened her.{{ref/book|10|10}}
